disclaimer.label: Disclaimer
disclaimer.title: Continuous improvement
disclaimer.body: Noah Cursor is under active development as an intelligent project bootstrapper and AI workflow package manager. Features, registry assets, and IDE support keep expanding. Expect iteration — APIs, commands, and packaged Skills/Rules may change as the tool matures. Feedback is welcome while it grows.

roadmap.title: Growing next
roadmap.summary: Direction as the project continues — not a hard schedule.
items: Richer project detection and smarter bootstrap recommendations
More Skills, Rules, Prompts, MCP configs, and Presets in the registry
Deeper multi-assistant packaging and team workspace sync
Clearer docs, demos, and release notes as each version ships

releases.title: Intelligent bootstrap platform
releases.summary: Noah becomes an intelligent project bootstrapper and AI package manager — detect, recommend, confirm, install.
notes: Flagship bootstrap: stack detect, health scores, confirm-before-install, noah.config.json
Package manager commands: install/uninstall, lockfile, favorites, preview, trending
Multi-assistant targets (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Gemini, Codex, and more)
Interactive home menu leads with Bootstrap, then Skills / Rules / Presets
Add npm run demo for a CLI walkthrough of bootstrap and install flows

releases.title: Package homepage
releases.summary: Point the npm package homepage at the public documentation site.
notes: Update package homepage URL for the published CLI package

releases.title: Docs site + multi-IDE
releases.summary: Public GitHub Pages documentation and multi-IDE install support land with this patch.
notes: Ship GitHub Pages docs: How, Skills & Rules, Commands, and Releases
Add Skills & Rules catalog with detail modals and stack badges
Track releases in docs/releases.json from 1.5.7 (first public) onward
Sync Pages docs automatically on /publish-npm via sync-docs-release
Multi-IDE installs with --ide (Cursor default; Windsurf, Claude Code, and more)

releases.title: First public release
releases.summary: The first version decided for public use — the starting line for Noah Cursor as a product people can install and trust.
notes: Designated as the first public version for general use
Point Buy Me a Coffee links to the klnaufr support page
